title: Run the Founding Member beta campaign toward the January 1 launch

source.ref: Daniel November 4 audit and approved launch scope

detail: Daniel set the official launch for January 1, 2027, with beta participation through December 31, 2026. He approved Founding Member recognition for beta participants, preservation of existing paid commitments and retention of individual 72-hour paid offers. Implement one campaign contract covering dates, recognition and copy across source and published overrides. Use public member and host entry paths, existing-owner resume paths, meaningful activation measures, feedback and reviewed campaign drafts. Keep personal paid clocks distinct from beta enrollment. Do not use /offer as a neutral public entry. Coordinate protected launch, theme and marketing work with Claude. Activate delivery only after recipients, content and schedule are reviewed. 2026-11-09: code half built. lib/core/launch-dates.ts is the one contract (beta ends 2026-12-31, launch 2027-01-01, Founding Member name and line); BETA_ENDS_LABEL, FOUNDER_BADGE_ENDS_LABEL and the beta help articles read it. Not changed: OPENING_DATE_* in lib/site.ts and the onboarding North County opening copy (December 1; SCAN-885's probe pins that literal and a probe rewrite needs the owner's phrase), pricing_settings.beta_grace (a data row, not this PR) and every personal paid clock. Still open: reviewed campaign drafts (/mnt/project-files/campaign/FOUNDING-MEMBER-EMAIL-DRAFTS.md), authorized audience, signup and resume checks, delivery evidence.

verify.evidence: 41 existing focused offer and beta tests passed. Live /offer still mentions December 1 and a personal 72-hour offer. The inventory distinguishes paid annual Founder recognition, early-join copy and the activity achievement. Acceptance requires an authorized audience, accurate checkout and badge qualification, signup and resume checks at desktop/mobile sizes, accessibility, a READY deployment and delivery evidence.
